label: Devin
description: Branch `devin`, for Devin Desktop / Devin CLI (formerly Windsurf). Devin installs Claude-layout plugins as-is, but documents neither plugin commands/ nor ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in skill text, so commands become skills and the root becomes a placeholder. The devin-marketplace pins a sha, hence `tag`.

transforms.text: > **AgenTeX on {host}.** `<agentex-root>` stands for this plugin's install folder: `{root}` from the folder this file is in. Resolve it to an absolute path before you run or read anything that uses it. When a step says to dispatch a bundled agent (`qa-executor`, `api-executor`, `mobile-qa-executor`), start it as a subagent; ask the user anything you need before dispatching, because subagents cannot ask.

forbiddenText.why: not documented as expanded in skill text
